typescript.constants: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE for module-level; camelCase for local

secretsInCode.rule: No credentials, API keys, tokens, or passwords may appear in source code or committed configs.

postgresSqlQueries.rule: All PostgreSQL queries must use parameterized placeholders ($1, $2, :param) or an established ORM. String concatenation for query building is strictly forbidden.

databaseMigrations.rule: All DDL migrations must be wrapped in transactions (BEGIN; ... COMMIT;), use defensive clauses (IF NOT EXISTS), and avoid non-concurrent table rewrites on high-traffic tables.

foreignKeyIndexing.rule: Every foreign key column should have an index created to prevent table-level locking during parent key changes.

rules: All async functions must handle errors with try/catch or checked error returns.
All new environment variables must be documented in .env.example.
Database schema changes must include both forward and rollback SQL scripts.
